concerns.text: T001 raises exception on all three repository failures; plan.md mandates fallback to placeholder with disclaimer. T001 verification does not confirm placeholder disclaimer is present when used. Implement fallback logic in T001 or remove from plan.

FR-008 requires 'any substantial differences (e.g., changes in coefficient significance or effect size) must be documented.' T005 mentions outputs/model_comparison.txt but does not formally task the comparison or define what constitutes 'substantial.' Add explicit sub-task requiring coefficient-by-coefficient comparison with 95% CI overlap analysis.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 & T004 & T006 vs constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: T002 applies z-score standardization to entire dataset before train-test split in T004/T006. Constitution VI and standard ML practice require scaler fit only on training data. T002 must clarify that standardization occurs post-split, or T004/T006 must re-fit scaler on training set only.

FR-003 requires identifying '3–5 metabolite classes' with significant negative correlation. T003 identifies classes with q < 0.05 but does not enforce or verify the 3–5 count constraint. Add verification step that flags if result falls outside 3–5 range.

T007 'raw vs. standardized robustness check' re-runs OLS and Random Forest on non-standardized concentrations. Constitution VI mandates z-score standardization 'prior to statistical modeling.' Clarify whether raw-concentration models are exploratory-only (not official results) or remove the check entirely.

Spec assumes analysis is valid with N < 50 (power-limited). T001 does not task explicit verification that final dataset meets ≥50 species threshold or document outcome if N < 50. Add verification step logging final species count and linking to T008 power analysis.

SC-002 requires R² > 0.3 threshold verification. T004 and T006 log warnings if R² < 0.1 but do not verify against 0.3 or document pass/fail in structured output. Add verification step checking R² against 0.3 and logging result to outputs/sc002_verification.txt.

T001 specifies fetch functions return columns (species_id, species_name, family, alkaloids, terpenes, phenolics, benzoxazinoids, herbivory_score). T002 'harmonizes column names' but does not document the exact mapping from source names to standardized names. Add mapping table or reference in T002.

T005 retrieves phylogeny from 'Open Tree of Life (OTL) via the OTL API' but does not task documentation of exact API endpoint, version, or access date. Add requirement to log OTL API endpoint and access timestamp in outputs/phylogeny_matching_log.txt.

Plan.md Phase 5 specifies both PGLS and mixed-effects models but does not explicitly task a three-way comparison (OLS vs PGLS vs mixed-effects). Current task structure treats them as parallel analyses. Clarify whether comparison is required or state that PGLS and mixed-effects are independent.
